datasheet.title: 5V Single-Pole Double-Throw (SPDT) 10A Optocoupled Power Relay
datasheet.description: The SRD-05VDC-SL-C relay module provides safe galvanic electrical isolation between low-power microcontroller logic (Arduino/ESP32) and high-power AC or DC electrical loads up to 250VAC @ 10A. Built with an on-board PC817 optocoupler, flyback suppression diode, transistor driver, and switching indicator LED.

pinout.name: VCC (Coil Power Rail)
pinout.desc: +5.0V DC supply to power electromagnet relay coil

pinout.name: IN (Digital Trigger Input)
pinout.desc: Control signal input; activates coil through optocoupler (Active HIGH / LOW selectable)

pinout.name: NO (Normally Open Contact)
pinout.desc: Load terminal connected to COM ONLY when relay is energized

pinout.name: COM (Common Contact)
pinout.desc: Common switch pole connected to load supply or hot line

pinout.name: NC (Normally Closed Contact)
pinout.desc: Load terminal connected to COM when relay coil is de-energized

datasheet.appNotes: Galvanic isolation protects delicate digital processors from mains spikes, noise, and back-EMF surges. Always observe electrical safety clearance rules when switching 120V/240V AC mains lines.
